reports.title: Tier 1 default-transport validation
reports.verdict: Correctness-backed Tier 1 default selection; not an overall performance win. Ordinary-route throughput vs old Tier 1 ranges -5.1% to +3.7% in median with overlapping spreads; POST c512 and known-length stream c512 p99 medians regress. No leaderboard update.

provenance.cpu: Apple M1 Pro host; server CPUs 0-3 with 2 event-loop threads; client CPUs 4-7
provenance.generator: whitethroated-benchmark-client pre loop-distribution fix (requests 4 threads, uses 2); TCP_NODELAY flag 0 with effective value unverified, see socket-options erratum
